title: Warm Malty British Grape Nuts Skewers
description: A light and crowd-pleasing British dish featuring Grape Nuts cereal, perfect for a snack or dessert. This malty treat is easy to make and fun to eat.
instructions: Preheat the robata grill to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the malt syrup, honey, and melted butter until well combined.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs, plain yogurt, and vanilla extract until smooth.
Add the crushed Grape Nuts cereal to the egg mixture and stir until the cereal is evenly coated.
Add the malt syrup mixture to the cereal mixture and stir until a thick batter forms.
Thread a small amount of the batter onto each skewer, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on the robata grill and cook for 5-7 minutes, or until the cereal is lightly toasted.
Serve the Warm Malty British Grape Nuts Skewers hot, garnished with additional malt syrup if desired.
